provisional_reason: Lane B's tests/fixtures (claims.json, session1.jsonl, session2.jsonl) were not merged into build/engram-v2 when this file was written, so there are no claim ids to point at. Each query therefore carries stable FACT KEYS in gold_facts / refuted_facts instead of claim ids. Fill bench/gold_map.json (fact key -> [claim ids]) once lane B merges and pass it to metrics.load_queries(); the set stays provisional until every key resolves, and engram/report/render.py prints 'provisional' next to any number derived from it.
source: docs/CUJ-engram-v2.md §3 (the Monday/Wednesday/Friday journey) and the design conversation those fixtures are drawn from (CUJ §2: 'the project under discussion is this one').

fact_keys.fact.project: The project is Engram, a self-managing memory for a builder's agent.
fact_keys.fact.chat_surface: The chat surface is pi (pi.dev), the terminal coding agent, in interactive mode.
fact_keys.fact.deploy_target: Engram runs as a local Python process (stdio server) spawned by a thin pi extension.
fact_keys.fact.model: The chat model is a ~4B open-weight model served by LM Studio.
fact_keys.fact.judge: claude-sonnet-5 judges accuracy, via the Anthropic API, as an offline batch.
fact_keys.fact.benchmark: The outcome benchmark is a LongMemEval slice covering all six categories.
fact_keys.fact.store: Storage is one SQLite file plus markdown exports, behind the frozen Store interface.
fact_keys.fact.vendor_sdk: The project uses a vendor SDK.
fact_keys.absence.sdk_batch_write: Stated absence: the vendor SDK has no batch-write endpoint. REFUTED in session 2.
fact_keys.prov.absence_source: Provenance of the absence claim: from the SDK docs, a while ago — not from trying it.
fact_keys.fact.sdk_batch_write_34: Correction: the SDK shipped batch writes in 3.4.
fact_keys.rule.structural_firing: Memory fires from pi lifecycle hooks, never at the model's request.
fact_keys.rule.never_hard_delete: Never hard-delete; refutation sets status and valid_to.
fact_keys.rule.only_p2_writes: Only the p2 gate writes to stores.
fact_keys.fact.capture_first: Capture first: every turn is appended verbatim to the episodic log before anything judges it.
fact_keys.fact.consolidation_dag: Consolidation is an explicit acyclic DAG run between sessions.
fact_keys.fact.evolution_generations: One generation per consolidation: mutate, replay, keep the best, revert on regression.
fact_keys.rule.one_clarifying_question: At most one clarifying question per session, only for an under-provenanced absence claim.
fact_keys.fact.vector_a3: The naive vector arm keeps returning the refuted claim (A-3).
fact_keys.fact.scorecard_five: The scorecard is five metrics in order: speed, accuracy, tokens, precision, recall.
fact_keys.fact.no_network_chat_loop: The chat loop runs with no network; only the judge needs a key.
fact_keys.fact.recall_token_budget: Recall is capped by a token budget, ENGRAM_RECALL_TOKENS, default 400.
fact_keys.fact.micro_sleep: Consolidation also runs every N turns (ENGRAM_MICRO_SLEEP, default 10).
